notes.text: sync() unconditionally writes meta/tag-index.yaml (_sync_tag_index) with no mkdir guard, so calling sync() against a vault whose meta/ directory does not yet exist raises FileNotFoundError. demote.py and make_unit.py's --undo mode both mkdir(exist_ok=True) meta/ immediately before calling sync() for this reason - any new caller of sync() on a possibly-fresh vault needs the same guard.
